flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

flavorText.black-white: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
flavorText.x-y: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

flavorText.black-white: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
flavorText.x-y: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

flavorText.black-white: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
flavorText.x-y: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

flavorText.black-white: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
flavorText.x-y: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

flavorText.black-white: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
flavorText.x-y: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

flavorText.black-white: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.
flavorText.x-y: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

flavorText.black-white: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
flavorText.x-y: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

flavorText.black-white: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
flavorText.x-y: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

flavorText.black-white: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
flavorText.x-y: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

flavorText.black-white: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
flavorText.x-y: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

flavorText.black-white: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
flavorText.x-y: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

flavorText.black-white: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.
flavorText.x-y: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
flavorText.sun-moon: Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can’t defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

flavorText.black-white: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can’t easily penetrate it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

flavorText.black-white: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.
flavorText.x-y: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
flavorText.sun-moon: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.
flavorText.sword-shield: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

flavorText.black-white: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
flavorText.x-y: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
flavorText.sword-shield: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

flavorText.black-white: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
flavorText.x-y: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
flavorText.sword-shield: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
flavorText.x-y: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

flavorText.black-white: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
flavorText.x-y: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

flavorText.black-white: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
flavorText.x-y: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

flavorText.black-white: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
flavorText.x-y: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

flavorText.black-white: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
flavorText.x-y: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

flavorText.black-white: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
flavorText.x-y: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

flavorText.black-white: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
flavorText.sword-shield: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

flavorText.black-white: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
flavorText.x-y: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
flavorText.sword-shield: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

flavorText.black-white: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
flavorText.x-y: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
flavorText.sword-shield: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

flavorText.black-white: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
flavorText.x-y: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

flavorText.black-white: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.
flavorText.x-y: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
flavorText.sword-shield: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

flavorText.black-white: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
flavorText.x-y: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

flavorText.black-white: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
flavorText.x-y: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

flavorText.black-white: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear. It has a tendency to walk in the direction the sound is coming from.
flavorText.x-y: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
flavorText.sun-moon: Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

flavorText.black-white: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
flavorText.x-y: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.
flavorText.sword-shield: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.

flavorText.black-white: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
flavorText.x-y: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
flavorText.sun-moon: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.
flavorText.sword-shield: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

flavorText.black-white: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
flavorText.x-y: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
flavorText.sword-shield: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

flavorText.black-white: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
flavorText.x-y: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
flavorText.sword-shield: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

flavorText.black-white: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
flavorText.x-y: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
flavorText.sword-shield: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

flavorText.black-white: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.
flavorText.x-y: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

flavorText.black-white: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
flavorText.x-y: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
flavorText.sword-shield: Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.

flavorText.black-white: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
flavorText.x-y: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
flavorText.sword-shield: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
flavorText.x-y: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
flavorText.sword-shield: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

flavorText.black-white: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
flavorText.x-y: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
flavorText.sword-shield: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

flavorText.black-white: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
flavorText.x-y: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
flavorText.sword-shield: Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

flavorText.black-white: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
flavorText.x-y: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
flavorText.sword-shield: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

flavorText.black-white: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
flavorText.x-y: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
flavorText.sword-shield: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

flavorText.black-white: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
flavorText.x-y: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
flavorText.sword-shield: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

flavorText.black-white: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
flavorText.x-y: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
flavorText.sword-shield: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.

flavorText.black-white: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

flavorText.black-white: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
flavorText.x-y: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

flavorText.black-white: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
flavorText.x-y: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

flavorText.black-white: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey’s location and state.
flavorText.x-y: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
flavorText.sword-shield: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

flavorText.black-white: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.
flavorText.x-y: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

flavorText.black-white: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
flavorText.x-y: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
flavorText.sword-shield: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.

flavorText.black-white: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.
flavorText.x-y: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can’t move as well.
flavorText.sword-shield: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

flavorText.black-white: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
flavorText.x-y: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
flavorText.sun-moon: It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This nuisance sneaks into people’s homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.
flavorText.sword-shield: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

flavorText.black-white: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
flavorText.x-y: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.
flavorText.sword-shield: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

flavorText.black-white: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
flavorText.x-y: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
flavorText.sun-moon: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.
flavorText.legends-arceus: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

flavorText.black-white: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
flavorText.x-y: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
flavorText.sword-shield: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

flavorText.black-white: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.
flavorText.x-y: It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
flavorText.sun-moon: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Alola, where it’s warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you’ll even see it outside of deserts.
flavorText.sword-shield: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

flavorText.black-white: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.
flavorText.x-y: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
flavorText.sun-moon: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.
flavorText.sword-shield: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

flavorText.black-white: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
flavorText.x-y: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

flavorText.black-white: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.
flavorText.x-y: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
flavorText.sword-shield: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

flavorText.black-white: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
flavorText.x-y: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
flavorText.sword-shield: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

flavorText.black-white: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.
flavorText.x-y: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
flavorText.sword-shield: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
flavorText.x-y: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
flavorText.sword-shield: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

flavorText.black-white: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
flavorText.x-y: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
flavorText.sword-shield: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

flavorText.black-white: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
flavorText.x-y: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

flavorText.black-white: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
flavorText.x-y: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
flavorText.sword-shield: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.

flavorText.black-white: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
flavorText.x-y: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
flavorText.sword-shield: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

flavorText.black-white: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
flavorText.x-y: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
flavorText.sword-shield: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

flavorText.black-white: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
flavorText.x-y: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

flavorText.black-white: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
flavorText.x-y: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
flavorText.sun-moon: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

flavorText.black-white: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
flavorText.x-y: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
flavorText.sun-moon: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.
flavorText.sword-shield: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own shell grows thick and sturdy.

flavorText.black-white: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.
flavorText.x-y: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.

flavorText.black-white: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
flavorText.x-y: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This ancient Pokémon’s plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.
flavorText.sword-shield: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

flavorText.black-white: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
flavorText.x-y: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

flavorText.black-white: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
flavorText.x-y: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
flavorText.sun-moon: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It locks opponents in place with its left hand, immobilizing them by entirely dousing their bodies with poisonous liquid.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

flavorText.black-white: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
flavorText.x-y: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
flavorText.sword-shield: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

flavorText.black-white: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
flavorText.x-y: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.
flavorText.legends-arceus: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

flavorText.black-white: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
flavorText.x-y: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
flavorText.sword-shield: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

flavorText.black-white: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
flavorText.x-y: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

flavorText.black-white: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn’t notice attacks.
flavorText.x-y: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
flavorText.sword-shield: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

flavorText.black-white: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
flavorText.x-y: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

flavorText.black-white: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can see the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s life span, it cries in sadness.
flavorText.x-y: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

flavorText.black-white: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
flavorText.x-y: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
flavorText.sword-shield: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

flavorText.black-white: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
flavorText.x-y: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
flavorText.black-white: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
flavorText.x-y: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
flavorText.sword-shield: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

flavorText.black-white: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
flavorText.x-y: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

flavorText.black-white: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
flavorText.x-y: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

flavorText.black-white: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.
flavorText.x-y: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
flavorText.sun-moon: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit. When it’s in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.
flavorText.sword-shield: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

flavorText.black-white: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
flavorText.x-y: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
flavorText.sun-moon: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It sprays its enemies with grains of ice to freeze them. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.
flavorText.sword-shield: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

flavorText.black-white: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.
flavorText.x-y: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
flavorText.sun-moon: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.
flavorText.sword-shield: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

flavorText.black-white: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
flavorText.x-y: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

flavorText.black-white: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
flavorText.x-y: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

flavorText.black-white: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.
flavorText.x-y: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
flavorText.sun-moon: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.
flavorText.sword-shield: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

flavorText.black-white: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
flavorText.x-y: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

flavorText.black-white: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
flavorText.x-y: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
flavorText.sword-shield: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

flavorText.black-white: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
flavorText.x-y: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
flavorText.sword-shield: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

flavorText.black-white: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
flavorText.x-y: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

flavorText.black-white: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.
flavorText.x-y: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
flavorText.sword-shield: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean’s surface.

flavorText.black-white: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
flavorText.x-y: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
flavorText.sword-shield: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

flavorText.black-white: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.
flavorText.x-y: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
flavorText.sun-moon: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there’ll be no need for a doctor or medicine.

flavorText.black-white: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
flavorText.x-y: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
flavorText.sword-shield: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

flavorText.black-white: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.
flavorText.x-y: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
flavorText.sword-shield: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

flavorText.black-white: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.
flavorText.x-y: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
flavorText.sword-shield: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

flavorText.black-white: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
flavorText.x-y: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

flavorText.black-white: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.
flavorText.x-y: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
flavorText.sword-shield: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

flavorText.black-white: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.
flavorText.x-y: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
flavorText.sword-shield: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

flavorText.black-white: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.
flavorText.x-y: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
flavorText.sword-shield: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

flavorText.black-white: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
flavorText.x-y: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

flavorText.black-white: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
flavorText.x-y: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

flavorText.black-white: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
