flavorText.black-2-white-2: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.
flavorText.x-y: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

flavorText.black-white: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
flavorText.x-y: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
flavorText.sword-shield: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

flavorText.black-white: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
flavorText.x-y: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents’ memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
flavorText.sword-shield: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

flavorText.black-white: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
flavorText.sword-shield: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

flavorText.black-white: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
flavorText.x-y: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary of death.

flavorText.black-white: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.
flavorText.x-y: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

flavorText.black-white: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.
flavorText.x-y: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
flavorText.sword-shield: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other’s strength.

flavorText.black-white: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.
flavorText.x-y: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
flavorText.sword-shield: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

flavorText.black-white: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.
flavorText.x-y: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

flavorText.black-white: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.
flavorText.x-y: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
flavorText.sword-shield: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn’t like.

flavorText.black-white: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
flavorText.x-y: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
flavorText.sword-shield: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

flavorText.black-white: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.
flavorText.x-y: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
flavorText.sword-shield: With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it encounters. It then takes its victims away to somewhere unknown.

flavorText.black-white: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
flavorText.x-y: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
flavorText.sword-shield: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

flavorText.black-white: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.
flavorText.x-y: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
flavorText.sword-shield: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

flavorText.black-white: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When its opponent can’t be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.
flavorText.x-y: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
flavorText.sword-shield: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

flavorText.black-white: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
flavorText.x-y: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
flavorText.sword-shield: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

flavorText.black-white: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
flavorText.x-y: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
flavorText.sword-shield: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

flavorText.black-white: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
flavorText.x-y: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
flavorText.sword-shield: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.

flavorText.black-white: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
flavorText.x-y: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
flavorText.sword-shield: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

flavorText.black-white: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
flavorText.x-y: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.
flavorText.sword-shield: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

flavorText.black-white: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
flavorText.x-y: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
flavorText.sword-shield: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

flavorText.black-white: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
flavorText.x-y: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it’s said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

flavorText.black-white: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.
flavorText.x-y: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
flavorText.sword-shield: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

flavorText.black-white: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.
flavorText.x-y: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
flavorText.sun-moon: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

flavorText.black-white: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
flavorText.x-y: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
flavorText.sun-moon: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it’s considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.
flavorText.sword-shield: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

flavorText.black-white: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
flavorText.x-y: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
flavorText.sun-moon: It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Mandibuzz gives it the bones it wears. Vullaby’s wings are short, so it can’t fly yet, but it jumps around, dreaming of wide open skies.
flavorText.sword-shield: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

flavorText.black-white: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
flavorText.x-y: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
flavorText.sun-moon: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
flavorText.sword-shield: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.

flavorText.black-white: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
flavorText.x-y: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
flavorText.sword-shield: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

flavorText.black-white: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
flavorText.x-y: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
flavorText.sword-shield: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

flavorText.black-white: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
flavorText.x-y: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
flavorText.sword-shield: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

flavorText.black-white: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
flavorText.x-y: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
flavorText.sword-shield: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

flavorText.black-white: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
flavorText.x-y: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
flavorText.sword-shield: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
flavorText.x-y: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.sword-shield: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

flavorText.black-white: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.
flavorText.x-y: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
flavorText.sword-shield: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

flavorText.black-white: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
flavorText.x-y: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
flavorText.sword-shield: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

flavorText.black-white: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
flavorText.x-y: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

flavorText.black-white: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.
flavorText.x-y: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

flavorText.black-white: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
flavorText.x-y: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
flavorText.sword-shield: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.

flavorText.black-white: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
flavorText.x-y: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
flavorText.sword-shield: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

flavorText.black-white: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
flavorText.x-y: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
flavorText.legends-arceus: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

flavorText.black-white: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
flavorText.x-y: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
flavorText.sword-shield: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

flavorText.black-white: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
flavorText.x-y: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
flavorText.sword-shield: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.

flavorText.black-white: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
flavorText.x-y: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

flavorText.black-white: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
flavorText.x-y: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
